summary: Kamada Ltd, an Israeli pharmaceutical company, filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited interim financial statements for the six months ended June 30, 2026, along with related operating and financial review. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer periodic report and does not announce any M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation corporate event. No transaction terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. The report covers standard segment and financial data, including contingent consideration and derivatives fair values, with no indication of imminent corporate action. As such, this is not a special-situation filing.
